entries.example: 這份新工作很有挑戰性。
entries.exampleEnglish: This new job is very challenging.
entries.question: 你覺得學中文有挑戰性嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think learning Chinese is challenging?
entries.answer: 很有挑戰性，尤其是聲調。
entries.answerEnglish: It's very challenging, especially the tones.

entries.example: 他對乾淨有一種執念，每天都要拖地。
entries.exampleEnglish: He has an obsession with cleanliness; he mops the floor every day.
entries.question: 你對什麼事情有執念嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there anything you're obsessed with?
entries.answer: 我對準時有執念，從來不遲到。
entries.answerEnglish: I'm obsessed with being on time; I'm never late.

entries.example: 我們下午三點吃點心。
entries.exampleEnglish: We have a snack at three in the afternoon.
entries.question: 你下午喜歡吃什麼點心？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you like to have as an afternoon snack?
entries.answer: 我喜歡吃蛋糕當點心。
entries.answerEnglish: I like to have cake as a snack.

entries.example: 他缺乏工作經驗。
entries.exampleEnglish: He lacks work experience.
entries.question: 你覺得自己缺乏什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you feel you lack?
entries.answer: 我覺得自己缺乏耐心。
entries.answerEnglish: I feel I lack patience.

entries.example: 公司下週要部署新的系統。
entries.exampleEnglish: The company will deploy a new system next week.
entries.question: 你的公司最近部署了什麼新東西？
entries.questionEnglish: What new things has your company rolled out recently?
entries.answer: 我們最近部署了新的會議軟體。
entries.answerEnglish: We recently rolled out new meeting software.

entries.example: 他的話裡隱含著不滿。
entries.exampleEnglish: There was an implied dissatisfaction in what he said.
entries.question: 你覺得廣告常隱含什麼訊息？
entries.questionEnglish: What messages do you think ads often imply?
entries.answer: 很多廣告隱含著買了東西就會快樂的意思。
entries.answerEnglish: Many ads imply that buying things will make you happy.

entries.example: 我常在咖啡館工作。
entries.exampleEnglish: I often work in cafes.
entries.question: 你常去咖啡館嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often go to cafes?
entries.answer: 常去，我週末都去咖啡館看書。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I go to a cafe to read every weekend.

entries.example: 這幾年台灣的咖啡店蓬勃發展。
entries.exampleEnglish: Coffee shops in Taiwan have been booming in recent years.
entries.question: 你覺得哪個行業正在蓬勃發展？
entries.questionEnglish: Which industry do you think is booming right now?
entries.answer: 我覺得人工智慧正在蓬勃發展。
entries.answerEnglish: I think AI is booming right now.

entries.example: 路上有一個凸起，騎車要小心。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a bump in the road, so be careful when you ride.
entries.question: 騎車時你會注意路面的凸起嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you watch out for bumps in the road when you ride?
entries.answer: 會，看到凸起我就會騎慢一點。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when I see a bump I slow down.

entries.example: 這部連續劇在講一個男人和他的情婦。
entries.exampleEnglish: This TV drama is about a man and his mistress.
entries.question: 為什麼很多連續劇都有情婦的角色？
entries.questionEnglish: Why do so many TV dramas have a mistress character?
entries.answer: 因為情婦的角色可以讓劇情更有衝突。
entries.answerEnglish: Because a mistress character adds more conflict to the plot.

entries.example: 她很有同情心，常常幫助別人。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's very compassionate and often helps others.
entries.question: 你覺得自己有同情心嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're a compassionate person?
entries.answer: 有，我很有同情心，常常餵流浪貓。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I'm very compassionate; I often feed stray cats.

entries.example: 這是全國性的比賽，很多人參加。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's a nationwide competition, and lots of people take part.
entries.question: 你參加過全國性的活動嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever taken part in a national event?
entries.answer: 參加過，我跑過一次全國性的馬拉松。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I once ran a national marathon.

entries.example: 工人在修理地下的管線。
entries.exampleEnglish: The workers are repairing the underground pipes.
entries.question: 你家的管線出過問題嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have the pipes in your home ever had problems?
entries.answer: 出過，浴室的管線去年塞住了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the bathroom pipes got clogged last year.

entries.example: 每個國家都想保護自己的領土。
entries.exampleEnglish: Every country wants to protect its own territory.
entries.question: 你的國家領土大不大？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your country's territory large?
entries.answer: 很大，我們國家的領土比台灣大很多。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country's territory is much bigger than Taiwan's.

entries.example: 這只是一種刻板印象。
entries.exampleEnglish: That's just a stereotype.
entries.question: 別人對你的國家有什麼刻板印象？
entries.questionEnglish: What stereotypes do people have about your country?
entries.answer: 很多人有刻板印象，覺得我們都很會滑雪。
entries.answerEnglish: Many people have the stereotype that we're all good at skiing.

entries.example: 他們開會時討論得很激烈。
entries.exampleEnglish: They had a heated discussion in the meeting.
entries.question: 你喜歡看比賽很激烈的運動嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like watching sports with intense games?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最愛看激烈的籃球比賽。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love watching intense basketball games.

entries.example: 夜市裡有無數的小吃攤。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are countless food stalls at the night market.
entries.question: 有什麼電影你看過無數次？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a movie you've watched countless times?
entries.answer: 有一部卡通，我小時候看過無數次。
entries.answerEnglish: There's a cartoon I watched countless times as a kid.

entries.example: 因為颱風，會議延後了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The meeting was postponed because of the typhoon.
entries.question: 你最近有把什麼事情延後嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you put anything off recently?
entries.answer: 有，我把看牙醫的時間延後了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I postponed my dentist appointment.

entries.example: 這顆桃子好甜！
entries.exampleEnglish: This peach is so sweet!
entries.question: 你喜歡吃桃子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like peaches?
entries.answer: 喜歡，夏天的桃子最好吃。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, summer peaches are the best.

entries.example: 我每天用這個馬克杯喝咖啡。
entries.exampleEnglish: I drink coffee from this mug every day.
entries.question: 你有最喜歡的馬克杯嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a favorite mug?
entries.answer: 有，我最喜歡朋友送我的馬克杯。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my favorite is a mug a friend gave me.

entries.example: 他脾氣很火爆，常常跟人吵架。
entries.exampleEnglish: He has a fiery temper and often argues with people.
entries.question: 你身邊有脾氣火爆的人嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there anyone around you with an explosive temper?
entries.answer: 有，我老闆的脾氣有點火爆。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my boss is a bit hot-tempered.

entries.example: 夜市的烤香腸很好吃。
entries.exampleEnglish: The grilled sausages at the night market are delicious.
entries.question: 你吃過台灣香腸嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever had Taiwanese sausage?
entries.answer: 吃過，我很喜歡夜市的香腸。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I really like the sausages at night markets.

entries.example: 加班費剛好抵銷了計程車錢。
entries.exampleEnglish: The overtime pay just offset the taxi fares.
entries.question: 你覺得運動能抵銷吃宵夜嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think exercise can offset late-night snacking?
entries.answer: 可以抵銷一點，但不能天天吃。
entries.answerEnglish: It can offset it a little, but you can't eat them every day.

entries.example: 他把旅行的故事說得很生動。
entries.exampleEnglish: He told the story of his trip very vividly.
entries.question: 你喜歡看寫得很生動的小說嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like novels that are vividly written?
entries.answer: 喜歡，寫得生動的書我會一口氣看完。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I read vividly written books in one go.

entries.example: 他十年前移居到台灣。
entries.exampleEnglish: He moved to Taiwan ten years ago.
entries.question: 你為什麼移居台灣？
entries.questionEnglish: Why did you move to Taiwan?
entries.answer: 因為工作，我三年前移居台灣。
entries.answerEnglish: I moved to Taiwan three years ago for work.

entries.example: 對面車子的強光讓我看不清楚路。
entries.exampleEnglish: The glare from the oncoming car made it hard to see the road.
entries.question: 遇到刺眼的強光，你會怎麼辦？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when you face a dazzling glare?
entries.answer: 我會戴太陽眼鏡，擋住強光。
entries.answerEnglish: I put on sunglasses to block the glare.

entries.example: 報告有一個錯字，我馬上更正了。
entries.exampleEnglish: There was a typo in the report, and I corrected it right away.
entries.question: 別人叫錯你的名字，你會更正嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: If someone gets your name wrong, do you correct them?
entries.answer: 會，我會很客氣地更正他。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I correct them very politely.

entries.example: 週末我們去河邊野餐吧！
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's go for a picnic by the river this weekend!
entries.question: 你喜歡去哪裡野餐？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you like to go for picnics?
entries.answer: 我喜歡去大安森林公園野餐。
entries.answerEnglish: I like having picnics in Daan Forest Park.

entries.example: 兩台車在路口發生碰撞。
entries.exampleEnglish: Two cars collided at the intersection.
entries.question: 騎腳踏車要怎麼避免碰撞？
entries.questionEnglish: How can you avoid collisions when cycling?
entries.answer: 騎慢一點，注意路口，就能避免碰撞。
entries.answerEnglish: Ride slower and watch the intersections, and you can avoid collisions.

entries.example: 一大片鳥群從海上飛過。
entries.exampleEnglish: A huge flock of birds flew over the sea.
entries.question: 你在哪裡看過很大的鳥群？
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you seen a huge flock of birds?
entries.answer: 我在關渡的濕地看過很大的鳥群。
entries.answerEnglish: I saw a huge flock of birds at the Guandu wetlands.

entries.example: 他說要減肥，卻天天喝珍奶，真諷刺。
entries.exampleEnglish: He says he's on a diet but drinks bubble tea every day. How ironic.
entries.question: 你遇過很諷刺的事情嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has anything ironic ever happened to you?
entries.answer: 有，我買了傘以後就不下雨了，很諷刺。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, it stopped raining right after I bought an umbrella. So ironic.

entries.example: 打完疫苗以後，身體會產生抗體。
entries.exampleEnglish: After a vaccination, the body produces antibodies.
entries.question: 要怎麼知道身體有沒有抗體？
entries.questionEnglish: How can you find out whether the body has antibodies?
entries.answer: 可以去醫院驗血，檢查有沒有抗體。
entries.answerEnglish: You can get a blood test at a hospital to check for antibodies.

entries.example: 他看到公車來了，就猛衝過去。
entries.exampleEnglish: He saw the bus coming and dashed over.
entries.question: 你曾經為了趕捷運猛衝嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever dashed to catch the MRT?
entries.answer: 有，我常常猛衝去趕末班車。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often dash to catch the last train.

entries.example: 警察在街上擋住了一群暴民。
entries.exampleEnglish: The police stopped a mob in the street.
entries.question: 遇到暴民的時候，應該怎麼做？
entries.questionEnglish: What should people do if they run into a mob?
entries.answer: 應該馬上離開，遠離暴民並報警。
entries.answerEnglish: Leave right away, stay away from the mob, and call the police.

entries.example: 這位指揮家很有名。
entries.exampleEnglish: This conductor is very famous.
entries.question: 你知道哪位有名的指揮家？
entries.questionEnglish: Which famous conductors do you know?
entries.answer: 我知道小澤征爾，他是日本的指揮家。
entries.answerEnglish: I know Seiji Ozawa; he's a Japanese conductor.

entries.example: 她穿白色長裙，像仙女一樣。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's wearing a long white dress, like a fairy.
entries.question: 你小時候聽過仙女的故事嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you hear fairy stories as a child?
entries.answer: 聽過，我很喜歡仙女的故事。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I loved fairy stories.

entries.example: 今年很乾旱，水庫快沒水了。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's been very dry this year, and the reservoirs are almost empty.
entries.question: 你的國家常常發生乾旱嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country often have droughts?
entries.answer: 不常，但是夏天有時候會乾旱。
entries.answerEnglish: Not often, but sometimes there's a drought in summer.

entries.example: 這次旅行真難忘！
entries.exampleEnglish: This trip was truly unforgettable!
entries.question: 你最難忘的旅行是哪一次？
entries.questionEnglish: Which trip was the most memorable for you?
entries.answer: 我最難忘的是去花蓮那次。
entries.answerEnglish: The most memorable was my trip to Hualien.

entries.example: 這個國家有很多民兵組織。
entries.exampleEnglish: This country has many militia groups.
entries.question: 民兵和一般軍人有什麼不同？
entries.questionEnglish: How are militia members different from regular soldiers?
entries.answer: 民兵通常不是全職的軍人。
entries.answerEnglish: Militia members usually aren't full-time soldiers.

entries.example: 我的手機昨天升級了。
entries.exampleEnglish: My phone got upgraded yesterday.
entries.question: 搭飛機時，你會花錢升級座位嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you fly, do you pay to upgrade your seat?
entries.answer: 長途飛行的話，我會花錢升級。
entries.answerEnglish: On long-haul flights, I pay to upgrade.

entries.example: 我姪子最喜歡恐龍。
entries.exampleEnglish: My nephew loves dinosaurs most of all.
entries.question: 你小時候喜歡恐龍嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you like dinosaurs as a child?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我有很多恐龍玩具。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I had lots of dinosaur toys.

entries.example: 這次颱風很有破壞性。
entries.exampleEnglish: This typhoon was very destructive.
entries.question: 你覺得哪種天災最有破壞性？
entries.questionEnglish: Which kind of natural disaster do you think is the most destructive?
entries.answer: 我覺得地震最有破壞性。
entries.answerEnglish: I think earthquakes are the most destructive.

entries.example: 這個軟體跟我的電腦不相容。
entries.exampleEnglish: This software isn't compatible with my computer.
entries.question: 你的手機和電腦相容嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are your phone and computer compatible?
entries.answer: 相容，它們是同一個牌子的。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, they're the same brand.

entries.example: 我們在山上住了一間木屋。
entries.exampleEnglish: We stayed in a log cabin in the mountains.
entries.question: 你住過山上的木屋嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever stayed in a cabin in the mountains?
entries.answer: 住過，我在阿里山住過木屋。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I stayed in a cabin on Alishan.

entries.example: 台灣的濕氣很重。
entries.exampleEnglish: Taiwan is very humid.
entries.question: 你家怎麼處理濕氣？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you deal with the damp at home?
entries.answer: 我每天開除濕機，減少濕氣。
entries.answerEnglish: I run a dehumidifier every day to cut the moisture.

entries.example: 那面牆上長滿了藤蔓。
entries.exampleEnglish: That wall is covered in vines.
entries.question: 你家附近有長滿藤蔓的房子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a house covered in vines near where you live?
entries.answer: 有，巷子裡有一棟長滿藤蔓的老房子。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's an old house covered in vines in my lane.

entries.example: 面試要穿得體面一點。
entries.exampleEnglish: You should dress respectably for an interview.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼是體面的工作？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you think counts as a respectable job?
entries.answer: 我覺得能養活自己的工作都很體面。
entries.answerEnglish: I think any job that supports you is respectable.

entries.example: 捷運站裡有很多柱子。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of pillars in the MRT station.
entries.question: 你家裡有柱子嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there any pillars in your home?
entries.answer: 有，客廳中間有一根柱子。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a pillar in the middle of the living room.

entries.example: 這艘船的船身是白色的。
entries.exampleEnglish: The hull of this ship is white.
entries.question: 你坐過船身很大的船嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been on a ship with a huge hull?
entries.answer: 坐過，我坐過船身很長的郵輪。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've been on a cruise ship with a very long hull.

entries.example: 他在大學研究量子物理。
entries.exampleEnglish: He researches quantum physics at a university.
entries.question: 你對量子電腦有興趣嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you interested in quantum computers?
entries.answer: 有一點，不過量子物理太難懂了。
entries.answerEnglish: A little, but quantum physics is too hard to understand.

entries.example: 我早餐常吃穀片加牛奶。
entries.exampleEnglish: I often have cereal with milk for breakfast.
entries.question: 你早餐會吃穀片嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you eat cereal for breakfast?
entries.answer: 有時候，我喜歡穀片加優格。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. I like cereal with yogurt.

entries.example: 等結果的時候，我很不安。
entries.exampleEnglish: I felt very uneasy while waiting for the results.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你覺得不安？
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you feel uneasy?
entries.answer: 飛機一直搖的時候，我會覺得不安。
entries.answerEnglish: I feel uneasy when the plane keeps shaking.

entries.example: 有一個推銷員來按我家的門鈴。
entries.exampleEnglish: A salesman came and rang my doorbell.
entries.question: 你會跟推銷員聊天嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you chat with salespeople?
entries.answer: 不會，我通常直接拒絕推銷員。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I usually just turn salespeople down.

entries.example: 這兩家便利商店互相競爭。
entries.exampleEnglish: These two convenience stores compete with each other.
entries.question: 你的工作競爭激烈嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a lot of competition in your job?
entries.answer: 對，我們這一行競爭很激烈。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, competition in my line of work is fierce.

entries.example: 我坐船常常覺得噁心。
entries.exampleEnglish: I often feel sick on boats.
entries.question: 覺得噁心的時候，可以怎麼做？
entries.questionEnglish: What can you do when you feel nauseous?
entries.answer: 可以休息一下，喝點溫水，比較不會噁心。
entries.answerEnglish: Rest a little and drink some warm water, and you'll feel less sick.

entries.example: 媽媽是我們家的支柱。
entries.exampleEnglish: Mom is the pillar of our family.
entries.question: 誰是你生活中的支柱？
entries.questionEnglish: Who is the pillar of your life?
entries.answer: 我的家人是我最大的支柱。
entries.answerEnglish: My family is my biggest support.

entries.example: 吵架以後，他們終於和解了。
entries.exampleEnglish: After the argument, they finally made up.
entries.question: 跟朋友吵架後，你會主動和解嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: After a fight with a friend, do you take the first step to make up?
entries.answer: 會，我通常會先道歉，跟他和解。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I usually apologize first and make peace with them.

entries.example: 這個路口的塞車惡名昭彰。
entries.exampleEnglish: This intersection is notorious for its traffic jams.
entries.question: 你住的地方有惡名昭彰的路口嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a notorious intersection where you live?
entries.answer: 有，我家附近有一個惡名昭彰的路口，常常塞車。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a notorious intersection near my home that's always jammed.

entries.example: 這片海是有名的漁場。
entries.exampleEnglish: This sea is a famous fishing ground.
entries.question: 你的國家有很大的漁場嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country have large fishing grounds?
entries.answer: 有，我們北邊的海有很大的漁場。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the sea to our north has huge fishing grounds.

entries.example: 捷運站外有人在發傳單。
entries.exampleEnglish: Someone is handing out flyers outside the MRT station.
entries.question: 路上有人發傳單，你會拿嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: If someone hands out flyers on the street, do you take one?
entries.answer: 會，我通常會拿傳單，看一下再丟掉。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I usually take a flyer, glance at it and throw it away.

entries.example: 他說的話很惡毒。
entries.exampleEnglish: What he said was really vicious.
entries.question: 你在網路上看過惡毒的留言嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen vicious comments online?
entries.answer: 看過，有些人的留言真的很惡毒。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, some people's comments are really vicious.

entries.example: 鄰居們自發地打掃公園。
entries.exampleEnglish: The neighbors cleaned the park of their own accord.
entries.question: 你參加過自發的活動嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever joined a spontaneous, self-organized activity?
entries.answer: 有，我跟朋友自發去海邊撿垃圾。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my friends and I went to pick up trash on the beach on our own.

entries.example: 這份文件是公司機密。
entries.exampleEnglish: This document is company confidential.
entries.question: 你的工作要處理機密資料嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you handle confidential information at work?
entries.answer: 有時候，我們有一些客戶的機密資料。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. We have some confidential client data.

entries.example: 這裡的村民都很熱情。
entries.exampleEnglish: The villagers here are all very warm.
entries.question: 你去過的小村子，村民友善嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: In the small villages you've been to, were the villagers friendly?
entries.answer: 很友善，那裡的村民還請我喝茶。
entries.answerEnglish: Very friendly. The villagers there even invited me for tea.

entries.example: 這批貨明天會到。
entries.exampleEnglish: This batch of goods will arrive tomorrow.
entries.question: 你的公司最近有買一批新電腦嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your company bought a batch of new computers recently?
entries.answer: 有，上個月買了一批新電腦。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we bought a batch of new computers last month.

entries.example: 這件洋裝的設計很女性化。
entries.exampleEnglish: This dress has a very feminine design.
entries.question: 你覺得粉紅色很女性化嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think pink is very feminine?
entries.answer: 不會，我覺得粉紅色不一定女性化。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't think pink is necessarily feminine.

entries.example: 他們拿著火把走進山洞。
entries.exampleEnglish: They walked into the cave carrying torches.
entries.question: 你在哪裡看過人拿火把？
entries.questionEnglish: Where have you seen people carrying torches?
entries.answer: 我在電影和祭典裡看過人拿火把。
entries.answerEnglish: I've seen people carrying torches in movies and at festivals.

entries.example: 我們搭船去一座小島。
entries.exampleEnglish: We took a boat to a small island.
entries.question: 你去過台灣的哪些小島？
entries.questionEnglish: Which of Taiwan's small islands have you been to?
entries.answer: 我去過綠島，那是一座很美的小島。
entries.answerEnglish: I've been to Green Island; it's a beautiful little island.

entries.example: 他一邊開車一邊咒罵塞車。
entries.exampleEnglish: He cursed the traffic as he drove.
entries.question: 塞車的時候，你會咒罵嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you swear when you're stuck in traffic?
entries.answer: 不會，但我常聽到司機在車上咒罵。
entries.answerEnglish: No, but I often hear drivers cursing in their cars.

entries.example: 這個少年很會打籃球。
entries.exampleEnglish: This teenage boy is great at basketball.
entries.question: 你少年的時候喜歡做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What did you like to do as a teenager?
entries.answer: 我少年的時候很喜歡打電動。
entries.answerEnglish: As a teenager I loved playing video games.

entries.example: 我在捷運上遇到一位舊識。
entries.exampleEnglish: I ran into an old acquaintance on the MRT.
entries.question: 你在台灣遇過舊識嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever run into an old acquaintance in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 有，我在夜市巧遇一位大學的舊識。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I bumped into an old acquaintance from college at a night market.

entries.example: 他用手指彈了一下我的額頭。
entries.exampleEnglish: He flicked my forehead with his finger.
entries.question: 你小時候玩過彈額頭的遊戲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you play forehead-flicking games as a kid?
entries.answer: 玩過，輸的人就要被彈額頭。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, whoever lost got their forehead flicked.

entries.example: 他們過著簡樸的生活。
entries.exampleEnglish: They live a simple life.
entries.question: 你喜歡簡樸的生活嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like a simple life?
entries.answer: 喜歡，簡樸的生活讓我比較輕鬆。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, a simple life makes me feel more relaxed.

entries.example: 爺爺走路要用手杖。
entries.exampleEnglish: Grandpa needs a cane to walk.
entries.question: 你的家人有用手杖嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does anyone in your family use a cane?
entries.answer: 有，我奶奶出門都要帶手杖。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my grandma always takes a cane when she goes out.

entries.example: 請在貨單上簽名。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please sign the shipping list.
entries.question: 你的工作需要看貨單嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you need to read shipping lists at work?
entries.answer: 需要，我每天都要檢查貨單。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have to check the shipping lists every day.

entries.example: 這棵樹的樹皮很粗。
entries.exampleEnglish: The bark of this tree is very rough.
entries.question: 你看過樹皮很特別的樹嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a tree with unusual bark?
entries.answer: 看過，有一種樹的樹皮是白色的。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a kind of tree with white bark.

entries.example: 最近警察加強了路口的檢查。
entries.exampleEnglish: The police have recently stepped up checks at intersections.
entries.question: 你覺得你的中文哪方面要加強？
entries.questionEnglish: Which part of your Chinese do you think needs strengthening?
entries.answer: 我覺得我的聽力要加強。
entries.answerEnglish: I think my listening needs work.

entries.example: 這盒櫻桃好貴！
entries.exampleEnglish: This box of cherries is so expensive!
entries.question: 你喜歡吃櫻桃嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like cherries?
entries.answer: 喜歡，可是台灣的櫻桃很貴。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, but cherries are expensive in Taiwan.

entries.example: 做決定前，要想清楚後果。
entries.exampleEnglish: Before you decide, think through the consequences.
entries.question: 熬夜對你有什麼後果？
entries.questionEnglish: What are the consequences of staying up late for you?
entries.answer: 熬夜的後果就是第二天上班很累。
entries.answerEnglish: The consequence of staying up late is being exhausted at work the next day.

entries.example: 她穿了一件天鵝絨的外套。
entries.exampleEnglish: She wore a velvet jacket.
entries.question: 你有天鵝絨做的衣服嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have any clothes made of velvet?
entries.answer: 有，我有一件黑色的天鵝絨洋裝。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I have a black velvet dress.

entries.example: 這家書店是我的避難所。
entries.exampleEnglish: This bookstore is my refuge.
entries.question: 心情不好時，你的避難所在哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: When you're in a bad mood, where is your refuge?
entries.answer: 我的避難所是家附近的咖啡館。
entries.answerEnglish: My refuge is a cafe near my home.

entries.example: 我早餐吃火腿蛋餅。
entries.exampleEnglish: I had a ham egg crepe for breakfast.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃火腿嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like ham?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常吃火腿三明治。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often eat ham sandwiches.

entries.example: 我包包的帶子斷了。
entries.exampleEnglish: The strap on my bag broke.
entries.question: 你的包包帶子是長的還是短的？
entries.questionEnglish: Is the strap on your bag long or short?
entries.answer: 我包包的帶子很長，可以斜背。
entries.answerEnglish: My bag's strap is long, so I can wear it across my body.

entries.example: 這個新聞讓大家很憤怒。
entries.exampleEnglish: This news made everyone furious.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你覺得很憤怒？
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you feel outraged?
entries.answer: 看到有人亂丟垃圾，我會很憤怒。
entries.answerEnglish: When I see people littering, I get really angry.

entries.example: 我真是個笨蛋，又忘了帶鑰匙！
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm such an idiot, I forgot my keys again!
entries.question: 你什麼時候會覺得自己是笨蛋？
entries.questionEnglish: When do you feel like an idiot?
entries.answer: 我搭錯捷運的時候，會覺得自己是笨蛋。
entries.answerEnglish: When I take the wrong MRT line, I feel like an idiot.

entries.example: 我做沙拉都用初榨橄欖油。
entries.exampleEnglish: I always use virgin olive oil in salads.
entries.question: 你做菜會用初榨橄欖油嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you cook with virgin olive oil?
entries.answer: 會，我拌沙拉都用初榨橄欖油。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always dress salads with virgin olive oil.

entries.example: 這座橋橫跨整條河。
entries.exampleEnglish: This bridge spans the whole river.
entries.question: 你看過橫跨大海的橋嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a bridge that spans the sea?
entries.answer: 看過，澎湖有一座大橋橫跨海上。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a big bridge in Penghu that spans the sea.

entries.example: 小時候我很愛看馬戲團表演。
entries.exampleEnglish: As a child I loved watching circus shows.
entries.question: 你看過馬戲團的表演嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a circus show?
entries.answer: 看過，小時候爸媽帶我去看馬戲團。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my parents took me to the circus when I was little.

entries.example: 他戴著帽子，打扮得像牛仔。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's wearing a hat and dressed like a cowboy.
entries.question: 你看過牛仔電影嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen any cowboy movies?
entries.answer: 看過，我喜歡看老的牛仔電影。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like watching old cowboy movies.

entries.example: 這位醫生在地方上很有聲望。
entries.exampleEnglish: This doctor has great prestige in the local community.
entries.question: 你覺得哪種工作最有聲望？
entries.questionEnglish: Which kind of job do you think has the most prestige?
entries.answer: 我覺得醫生在台灣很有聲望。
entries.answerEnglish: I think doctors have a lot of prestige in Taiwan.

entries.example: 家裡附近有超商，很方便。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a convenience store near home, so it's very handy.
entries.question: 你家附近買東西方便嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is it convenient to shop near your home?
entries.answer: 很方便，樓下就有便利商店。
entries.answerEnglish: Very convenient. There's a convenience store downstairs.

entries.example: 這本小說的故事引人入勝。
entries.exampleEnglish: The story of this novel is gripping.
entries.question: 你最近看過引人入勝的劇嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you watched any gripping shows lately?
entries.answer: 有，我最近看的韓劇很引人入勝。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the Korean drama I'm watching is really gripping.

entries.example: 週末我會放縱一下，吃炸雞。
entries.exampleEnglish: On weekends I let myself go a bit and eat fried chicken.
entries.question: 你什麼時候會放縱自己大吃？
entries.questionEnglish: When do you let yourself indulge in a big meal?
entries.answer: 生日的時候，我會放縱自己吃蛋糕。
entries.answerEnglish: On my birthday I let myself indulge in cake.

entries.example: 夜市是美食的樂園。
entries.exampleEnglish: Night markets are a food paradise.
entries.question: 你心中的樂園在哪裡？
entries.questionEnglish: Where is your idea of paradise?
entries.answer: 我心中的樂園是海邊的小鎮。
entries.answerEnglish: My paradise is a little town by the sea.

entries.example: 這台迷你冰箱很可愛。
entries.exampleEnglish: This mini fridge is so cute.
entries.question: 你有什麼迷你的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have anything that's mini?
entries.answer: 我有一台迷你電風扇，夏天很好用。
entries.answerEnglish: I have a mini fan; it's really handy in summer.

entries.example: 我想吃宵夜，但我控制住了。
entries.exampleEnglish: I wanted a late-night snack, but I held back.
entries.question: 你可以控制自己不滑手機嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you control yourself and not scroll on your phone?
entries.answer: 很難，我常常控制不了自己。
entries.answerEnglish: It's hard. I often can't control myself.

entries.example: 週末我們去動物園看熊貓。
entries.exampleEnglish: We're going to the zoo to see the pandas this weekend.
entries.question: 你去過台北的動物園嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you been to the zoo in Taipei?
entries.answer: 去過，我很喜歡台北動物園。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I really like the Taipei Zoo.

entries.example: 我們終止了跟那家公司的合約。
entries.exampleEnglish: We terminated our contract with that company.
entries.question: 你曾經終止過手機合約嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever terminated a phone contract?
entries.answer: 有，我去年終止了舊的手機合約。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I terminated my old phone contract last year.

entries.example: 加油站的服務員很親切。
entries.exampleEnglish: The gas station attendant is very friendly.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的服務員親切嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think service staff in Taiwan are friendly?
entries.answer: 很親切，餐廳的服務員都很有禮貌。
entries.answerEnglish: Very friendly. Restaurant staff are all very polite.

entries.example: 我估計半小時就到了。
entries.exampleEnglish: I reckon we'll be there in half an hour.
entries.question: 從家裡到公司，你估計要多久？
entries.questionEnglish: How long do you reckon it takes from home to work?
entries.answer: 我估計大概要四十分鐘。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd estimate about forty minutes.

entries.example: 這家公司的口號很好記。
entries.exampleEnglish: This company's slogan is easy to remember.
entries.question: 你記得哪個廣告的口號？
entries.questionEnglish: Which advertising slogan do you remember?
entries.answer: 我記得全家便利商店的口號：全家就是你家。
entries.answerEnglish: I remember FamilyMart's slogan: FamilyMart is your home.

entries.example: 她的戒指上有一顆寶石。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a gem on her ring.
entries.question: 你喜歡什麼顏色的寶石？
entries.questionEnglish: What color gems do you like?
entries.answer: 我喜歡藍色的寶石。
entries.answerEnglish: I like blue gems.

entries.example: 進口車的關稅很高。
entries.exampleEnglish: The tariffs on imported cars are high.
entries.question: 你在網路上買國外的東西要付關稅嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have to pay customs duty when you buy things from abroad online?
entries.answer: 有時候要，買貴的東西就要付關稅。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. For expensive things I have to pay duty.

entries.example: 這次地震帶來災難性的損失。
entries.exampleEnglish: This earthquake caused catastrophic losses.
entries.question: 哪種天災可能造成災難性的影響？
entries.questionEnglish: Which natural disaster could have a catastrophic impact?
entries.answer: 我覺得大地震會造成災難性的影響。
entries.answerEnglish: I think a big earthquake would have a catastrophic impact.

entries.example: 她很天真，什麼話都相信。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's very naive and believes everything she hears.
entries.question: 你覺得自己天真嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're naive?
entries.answer: 以前很天真，現在比較不會了。
entries.answerEnglish: I used to be very naive, but not so much now.

entries.example: 這是季節性的水果，只有夏天有。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a seasonal fruit; it's only available in summer.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪種季節性的水果？
entries.questionEnglish: Which seasonal fruit do you like best?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡芒果，它是夏天季節性的水果。
entries.answerEnglish: I like mangoes best; they're a seasonal summer fruit.

entries.example: 這件襯衫的針腳很整齊。
entries.exampleEnglish: The stitching on this shirt is very neat.
entries.question: 你買衣服時會看針腳嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you check the stitching when you buy clothes?
entries.answer: 會，我會看針腳整不整齊。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I check whether the stitching is neat.

entries.example: 衣服上還殘留著香水味。
entries.exampleEnglish: The smell of perfume still lingers on the clothes.
entries.question: 你會擔心蔬菜有農藥殘留嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you worry about pesticide residue on vegetables?
entries.answer: 會，所以我洗菜會多洗幾次，減少殘留。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, so I wash vegetables a few extra times to reduce the residue.

entries.example: 裁判吹哨了，比賽開始！
entries.exampleEnglish: The referee blew the whistle, and the game began!
entries.question: 你當過比賽的裁判嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been a referee for a game?
entries.answer: 當過，我在公司的籃球賽當過裁判。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I refereed at my company's basketball game.

entries.example: 這是一家專門賣茶的店。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a shop that specializes in tea.
entries.question: 你家附近有專門賣咖啡豆的店嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a shop near you that specializes in coffee beans?
entries.answer: 有，巷口有一家專門賣咖啡豆的店。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there's a coffee bean shop at the end of my lane.

entries.example: 博物館裡有一具恐龍骨骸。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a dinosaur skeleton in the museum.
entries.question: 在哪裡可以看到恐龍的骨骸？
entries.questionEnglish: Where can you see dinosaur skeletons?
entries.answer: 在科學博物館可以看到恐龍的骨骸。
entries.answerEnglish: You can see dinosaur skeletons at the science museum.

entries.example: 我喜歡在氣泡水裡加萊姆。
entries.exampleEnglish: I like adding lime to sparkling water.
entries.question: 你喜歡萊姆的味道嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like the taste of lime?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我吃泰國菜都會擠萊姆。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always squeeze lime on Thai food.

entries.example: 行李請放在座位上方。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please put your luggage above your seat.
entries.question: 你的辦公桌上方有什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's above your desk?
entries.answer: 我的辦公桌上方有一排書架。
entries.answerEnglish: There's a row of bookshelves above my desk.

entries.example: 這件外套很好搭配。
entries.exampleEnglish: This jacket goes with everything.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼飲料最適合搭配鹽酥雞？
entries.questionEnglish: Which drink do you think goes best with popcorn chicken?
entries.answer: 我覺得冰啤酒最適合搭配鹽酥雞。
entries.answerEnglish: I think cold beer goes best with popcorn chicken.

entries.example: 這家酒吧的燈光很昏暗。
entries.exampleEnglish: The lighting in this bar is very dim.
entries.question: 你喜歡燈光昏暗的餐廳嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like dimly lit restaurants?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，太昏暗我看不清楚菜單。
entries.answerEnglish: No, when it's too dim I can't read the menu.

entries.example: 他們在婚禮上說了誓言。
entries.exampleEnglish: They said their vows at the wedding.
entries.question: 你覺得結婚誓言重要嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think wedding vows are important?
entries.answer: 很重要，誓言代表兩個人的承諾。
entries.answerEnglish: Very important. Vows stand for the couple's commitment.

entries.example: 昨天下午突然下冰雹。
entries.exampleEnglish: It suddenly hailed yesterday afternoon.
entries.question: 你看過下冰雹嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen hail?
entries.answer: 看過，我在家鄉看過很大的冰雹。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've seen huge hailstones in my hometown.

entries.example: 過年前夕，車站人很多。
entries.exampleEnglish: On the eve of Lunar New Year, the stations are crowded.
entries.question: 出國的前夕，你會做什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do the night before you go abroad?
entries.answer: 出國前夕，我會整理行李。
entries.answerEnglish: The night before I go abroad, I pack my bags.

entries.example: 停電時，醫院會用發電機。
entries.exampleEnglish: When the power goes out, hospitals use generators.
entries.question: 停電時，哪些地方需要發電機？
entries.questionEnglish: Which places need generators during a power outage?
entries.answer: 醫院和大樓都需要發電機。
entries.answerEnglish: Hospitals and big buildings need generators.

entries.example: 我的白襯衫上有一塊汙漬。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a stain on my white shirt.
entries.question: 衣服上有汙漬，你會怎麼處理？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you do when your clothes have a stain?
entries.answer: 我會先用肥皂洗掉汙漬。
entries.answerEnglish: I wash the stain out with soap first.

entries.example: 我早餐吃培根蛋餅。
entries.exampleEnglish: I had a bacon egg crepe for breakfast.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃培根嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like bacon?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我最愛培根三明治。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love bacon sandwiches.

entries.example: 冬天的草莓很甜。
entries.exampleEnglish: Strawberries in winter are very sweet.
entries.question: 你去採過草莓嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever gone strawberry picking?
entries.answer: 去過，我在大湖採過草莓。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've picked strawberries in Dahu.

entries.example: 這支口紅的顏色很持久。
entries.exampleEnglish: The color of this lipstick is long-lasting.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼樣的友誼比較持久？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of friendship do you think lasts longer?
entries.answer: 我覺得互相信任的友誼比較持久。
entries.answerEnglish: I think friendships built on mutual trust last longer.

entries.example: 她是一位有名的小說家。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's a famous novelist.
entries.question: 你最喜歡哪位小說家？
entries.questionEnglish: Who's your favorite novelist?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡日本小說家村上春樹。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite is the Japanese novelist Haruki Murakami.

entries.example: 他在南部經營一座咖啡種植園。
entries.exampleEnglish: He runs a coffee plantation in the south.
entries.question: 你參觀過咖啡種植園嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever visited a coffee plantation?
entries.answer: 參觀過，我去過雲林的咖啡種植園。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've visited a coffee plantation in Yunlin.

entries.example: 多吃蔬菜可以補充纖維。
entries.exampleEnglish: Eating more vegetables gives you more fiber.
entries.question: 你每天吃的纖維夠嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get enough fiber every day?
entries.answer: 不太夠，我應該多吃有纖維的蔬菜。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I should eat more vegetables with fiber.

entries.example: 我把花移植到大一點的盆子。
entries.exampleEnglish: I transplanted the flowers into a bigger pot.
entries.question: 植物長大了，你會幫它移植嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When a plant grows bigger, do you transplant it?
entries.answer: 會，我會把它移植到比較大的盆子。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I transplant it into a bigger pot.

entries.example: 多吃蔬菜對腸道很好。
entries.exampleEnglish: Eating more vegetables is good for your gut.
entries.question: 吃什麼對腸道比較好？
entries.questionEnglish: What foods are better for the gut?
entries.answer: 優格和蔬菜對腸道很好。
entries.answerEnglish: Yogurt and vegetables are good for the gut.

entries.example: 記者扭曲了他的意思。
entries.exampleEnglish: The reporter distorted what he meant.
entries.question: 你覺得新聞常常扭曲事實嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the news often distorts the facts?
entries.answer: 有些新聞會扭曲事實，要小心看。
entries.answerEnglish: Some news distorts the facts, so read carefully.

entries.example: 打雷的聲音讓我嚇一跳。
entries.exampleEnglish: The thunder startled me.
entries.question: 最近什麼事讓你嚇一跳？
entries.questionEnglish: What has startled you recently?
entries.answer: 電費帳單太貴，讓我嚇一跳。
entries.answerEnglish: The electricity bill was so high it gave me a fright.

entries.example: 這幾年房價急速上漲。
entries.exampleEnglish: Housing prices have risen rapidly in recent years.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的物價急速上漲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think prices in Taiwan are rising rapidly?
entries.answer: 對，這幾年物價急速上漲。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, prices have shot up these past few years.

entries.example: 路口的監視器可以嚇阻小偷。
entries.exampleEnglish: Security cameras at the intersection can deter thieves.
entries.question: 什麼方法可以嚇阻闖紅燈？
entries.questionEnglish: What can deter people from running red lights?
entries.answer: 裝更多監視器可以嚇阻闖紅燈。
entries.answerEnglish: Installing more cameras can deter red-light running.

entries.example: 用抹布把桌子擦乾淨。
entries.exampleEnglish: Wipe the table clean with a rag.
entries.question: 你多久洗一次抹布？
entries.questionEnglish: How often do you wash your cleaning cloths?
entries.answer: 我每次用完抹布都會洗。
entries.answerEnglish: I wash the cloth every time I use it.

entries.example: 早期的拓荒者在這裡開墾種田。
entries.exampleEnglish: Early settlers cleared the land and farmed here.
entries.question: 你的國家以前有很多拓荒者嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did your country have many settlers in the past?
entries.answer: 有，很多拓荒者從歐洲來到我們國家。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, many settlers came to my country from Europe.

entries.example: 表演結束，大家給了熱烈的掌聲。
entries.exampleEnglish: When the show ended, everyone gave warm applause.
entries.question: 你上台時得到過掌聲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever received applause on stage?
entries.answer: 有，我在尾牙唱歌，大家給我很多掌聲。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I sang at the year-end party and got lots of applause.

entries.example: 騎馬前要先放好馬鞍。
entries.exampleEnglish: Before riding, you need to put the saddle on properly.
entries.question: 你騎馬時坐過馬鞍嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever sat in a saddle while riding a horse?
entries.answer: 坐過，我在農場騎馬時坐過馬鞍。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I sat in a saddle when I rode a horse at a farm.

entries.example: 他對公司的不公感到很生氣。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's angry about the company's unfairness.
entries.question: 遇到不公的事，你會說出來嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you speak up when you see injustice?
entries.answer: 會，遇到不公的事我一定會說出來。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always speak up when something is unfair.

entries.example: 薪水扣掉房租，就沒剩多少了。
entries.exampleEnglish: After rent is deducted from my salary, there's not much left.
entries.question: 扣掉週末，你一個月工作幾天？
entries.questionEnglish: Not counting weekends, how many days a month do you work?
entries.answer: 扣掉週末，我一個月工作二十二天。
entries.answerEnglish: Minus weekends, I work twenty-two days a month.

entries.example: 寶特瓶要拿去回收。
entries.exampleEnglish: Plastic bottles should go to recycling.
entries.question: 你在家會做資源回收嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you recycle at home?
entries.answer: 會，我每天都會做資源回收。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I recycle every day.

entries.example: 這是新手機的原型。
entries.exampleEnglish: This is a prototype of the new phone.
entries.question: 你的工作會做產品原型嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you make product prototypes at work?
entries.answer: 會，我們常常先做一個原型來測試。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we often build a prototype first to test.

entries.example: 便當可以用微波爐加熱。
entries.exampleEnglish: You can heat up a lunch box in the microwave.
entries.question: 你常用微波爐熱東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often heat food in the microwave?
entries.answer: 常用，我中午都用微波爐熱便當。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I heat my lunch box in the microwave every day.

entries.example: 他很體貼，常幫我拿東西。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's very considerate and often carries things for me.
entries.question: 你身邊誰最體貼？
entries.questionEnglish: Who's the most considerate person around you?
entries.answer: 我先生最體貼，常常來接我下班。
entries.answerEnglish: My husband is the most considerate; he often picks me up after work.

entries.example: 很多候鳥在這片濕地棲息。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many migratory birds live in this wetland.
entries.question: 你看過棲息在公園裡的松鼠嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen squirrels living in the park?
entries.answer: 看過，大安森林公園有很多松鼠棲息。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, lots of squirrels live in Daan Forest Park.

entries.example: 我的簽證下個月到期。
entries.exampleEnglish: My visa expires next month.
entries.question: 你來台灣需要辦簽證嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you need a visa to come to Taiwan?
entries.answer: 需要，我來台灣前辦了簽證。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I got a visa before I came to Taiwan.

entries.example: 我懷疑他今天不會來。
entries.exampleEnglish: I doubt he'll come today.
entries.question: 你會懷疑網路上的新聞嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you skeptical of news online?
entries.answer: 會，我常常懷疑網路新聞是假的。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often suspect online news is fake.

entries.example: 她跳舞的樣子很優雅。
entries.exampleEnglish: She dances very gracefully.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼樣的人很優雅？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of person do you think is elegant?
entries.answer: 我覺得說話溫柔的人很優雅。
entries.answerEnglish: I think people who speak gently are elegant.

entries.example: 她是這個環保活動的推動者。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's the driving force behind this environmental campaign.
entries.question: 你想當哪種活動的推動者？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of campaign would you like to promote?
entries.answer: 我想當淨灘活動的推動者。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd like to be the one promoting beach clean-ups.

entries.example: 表演結束，大家一起鼓掌。
entries.exampleEnglish: When the show ended, everyone clapped.
entries.question: 看完電影，你會鼓掌嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you clap at the end of a movie?
entries.answer: 很少，只有很感動時才會鼓掌。
entries.answerEnglish: Rarely. Only when I'm really moved.

entries.example: 公司今年大幅削減預算。
entries.exampleEnglish: The company slashed its budget this year.
entries.question: 如果要省錢，你會削減哪些花費？
entries.questionEnglish: If you needed to save money, which expenses would you cut?
entries.answer: 我會削減外食和買衣服的花費。
entries.answerEnglish: I'd cut spending on eating out and clothes.

entries.example: 我低估了台北的塞車。
entries.exampleEnglish: I underestimated the traffic in Taipei.
entries.question: 你曾經低估過什麼事情的難度？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever underestimated how hard something was?
entries.answer: 我低估了學中文的難度。
entries.answerEnglish: I underestimated how hard it is to learn Chinese.

entries.example: 週末我們去陽明山健行。
entries.exampleEnglish: We went hiking on Yangmingshan at the weekend.
entries.question: 你喜歡去哪裡健行？
entries.questionEnglish: Where do you like to go hiking?
entries.answer: 我喜歡去象山健行，風景很好。
entries.answerEnglish: I like hiking Elephant Mountain; the view is great.

entries.example: 每天都有很多瑣碎的事要做。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are lots of trivial things to do every day.
entries.question: 工作上哪些瑣碎的事最煩？
entries.questionEnglish: Which petty tasks at work are the most annoying?
entries.answer: 我覺得報帳這種瑣碎的事最煩。
entries.answerEnglish: I find petty stuff like filing expense claims the most annoying.

entries.example: 小孩拉了拉媽媽的衣服。
entries.exampleEnglish: The child tugged at his mom's clothes.
entries.question: 你家的門是推的還是拉的？
entries.questionEnglish: Is the door at your home a push door or a pull door?
entries.answer: 我家的門要用拉的。
entries.answerEnglish: You have to pull the door at my home.

entries.example: 這個包包是假的。
entries.exampleEnglish: This bag is fake.
entries.question: 你買過假的東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever bought something fake?
entries.answer: 買過，我在夜市買到假的手錶。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I bought a fake watch at a night market.

entries.example: 小朋友在公園裡單腳跳。
entries.exampleEnglish: The kids are hopping on one foot in the park.
entries.question: 你可以單腳跳多久？
entries.questionEnglish: How long can you hop on one foot?
entries.answer: 我可以單腳跳一分鐘左右。
entries.answerEnglish: I can hop on one foot for about a minute.

entries.example: 我每天運動，維持身體健康。
entries.exampleEnglish: I exercise every day to stay healthy.
entries.question: 你怎麼維持好心情？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you keep yourself in a good mood?
entries.answer: 我常聽音樂來維持好心情。
entries.answerEnglish: I often listen to music to keep my mood up.

entries.example: 他用笑容遮掩心裡的緊張。
entries.exampleEnglish: He used a smile to hide his nerves.
entries.question: 緊張的時候，你會怎麼遮掩？
entries.questionEnglish: When you're nervous, how do you hide it?
entries.answer: 我會一直笑，遮掩我的緊張。
entries.answerEnglish: I keep smiling to cover up my nerves.

entries.example: 很多國家提供人道救援。
entries.exampleEnglish: Many countries provide humanitarian aid.
entries.question: 你覺得人道救援重要嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think humanitarian aid is important?
entries.answer: 很重要，人道救援可以幫助很多人。
entries.answerEnglish: Very important. Humanitarian aid can help a lot of people.

entries.example: 把豆腐切成小方塊。
entries.exampleEnglish: Cut the tofu into small cubes.
entries.question: 你會玩魔術方塊嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you do a Rubik's cube?
entries.answer: 會一點，我只會拼好魔術方塊的一面。
entries.answerEnglish: A little. I can only solve one side of a Rubik's cube.

entries.example: 他不是壞人，別怕。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's not a bad guy, don't be scared.
entries.question: 你小時候很壞嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Were you naughty as a child?
entries.answer: 不壞，我小時候很乖。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I was very well-behaved as a kid.

entries.example: 她很有外交手腕，跟誰都處得好。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's very diplomatic and gets along with everyone.
entries.question: 你覺得工作需要外交手腕嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think your job requires diplomacy?
entries.answer: 需要，跟客戶溝通時要有外交手腕。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, you need diplomacy when dealing with clients.

entries.example: 灰塵附著在窗戶上。
entries.exampleEnglish: Dust clings to the windows.
entries.question: 你家什麼地方容易附著灰塵？
entries.questionEnglish: Where does dust tend to collect in your home?
entries.answer: 我家的電風扇最容易附著灰塵。
entries.answerEnglish: Dust sticks to the fan most easily in my home.

entries.example: 這個村子的人都屬於同一個宗族。
entries.exampleEnglish: The people in this village all belong to the same clan.
entries.question: 你的國家有宗族的觀念嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there a sense of clan in your country?
entries.answer: 比較少，我們國家的宗族觀念很淡。
entries.answerEnglish: Not much. The idea of clans is weak in my country.

entries.example: 歷史上，這座城市經歷過長期圍城。
entries.exampleEnglish: In history, this city went through a long siege.
entries.question: 圍城的時候，城裡的人最缺什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: During a siege, what do the people in the city lack most?
entries.answer: 圍城的時候，城裡最缺食物和水。
entries.answerEnglish: During a siege, the city is shortest of food and water.

entries.example: 他是一個很誠實的人。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's a very honest person.
entries.question: 你覺得誠實重要嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think honesty is important?
entries.answer: 很重要，我喜歡誠實的朋友。
entries.answerEnglish: Very important. I like honest friends.

entries.example: 這個社區由居民自治管理。
entries.exampleEnglish: This community is self-governed by its residents.
entries.question: 你的國家有自治的地區嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there any autonomous regions in your country?
entries.answer: 有，我們國家有幾個自治的地區。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my country has a few autonomous regions.

entries.example: 我在九份買了幾張明信片。
entries.exampleEnglish: I bought a few postcards in Jiufen.
entries.question: 你旅行時會寄明信片嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you send postcards when you travel?
entries.answer: 會，我常常寄明信片給家人。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often send postcards to my family.

entries.example: 淡水的日落很美。
entries.exampleEnglish: The sunsets in Tamsui are beautiful.
entries.question: 你最喜歡在哪裡看日落？
entries.questionEnglish: Where's your favorite place to watch the sunset?
entries.answer: 我最喜歡在淡水看日落。
entries.answerEnglish: My favorite place to watch the sunset is Tamsui.

entries.example: 新的美術館下個月揭幕。
entries.exampleEnglish: The new art museum opens next month.
entries.question: 你參加過什麼揭幕活動嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever attended an unveiling or opening ceremony?
entries.answer: 我參加過一個展覽的揭幕活動。
entries.answerEnglish: I went to the opening of an exhibition.

entries.example: 小孩的問題好像無窮無盡。
entries.exampleEnglish: Kids' questions seem endless.
entries.question: 你覺得什麼東西好像無窮無盡？
entries.questionEnglish: What do you feel seems endless?
entries.answer: 我覺得公司的會議好像無窮無盡。
entries.answerEnglish: I feel like the meetings at work are endless.

entries.example: 辦公室裡有很多流言。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are a lot of rumors going around the office.
entries.question: 你會相信辦公室的流言嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you believe office gossip?
entries.answer: 不會，我覺得流言大多不是真的。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I think most rumors aren't true.

entries.example: 我家的電器都是新買的。
entries.exampleEnglish: All the appliances in my home are new.
entries.question: 你家最常用的電器是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: Which appliance do you use most at home?
entries.answer: 我家最常用的電器是冷氣。
entries.answerEnglish: The appliance we use most at home is the air conditioner.

entries.example: 水龍頭一直在滴水。
entries.exampleEnglish: The faucet keeps dripping.
entries.question: 你家的水龍頭會滴水嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does the faucet in your home drip?
entries.answer: 會，浴室的水龍頭一直滴水。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the bathroom faucet keeps dripping.

entries.example: 胚胎在媽媽的肚子裡慢慢長大。
entries.exampleEnglish: The embryo slowly grows inside the mother's belly.
entries.question: 小雞的胚胎在哪裡長大？
entries.questionEnglish: Where does a chick embryo grow?
entries.answer: 小雞的胚胎在蛋裡面長大。
entries.answerEnglish: A chick embryo grows inside the egg.

entries.example: 愛因斯坦是有名的物理學家。
entries.exampleEnglish: Einstein is a famous physicist.
entries.question: 你知道哪些有名的物理學家？
entries.questionEnglish: Which famous physicists do you know of?
entries.answer: 我知道愛因斯坦和霍金，他們都是物理學家。
entries.answerEnglish: I know Einstein and Hawking; they were both physicists.

entries.example: 這個官員因為貪腐被抓了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This official was arrested for corruption.
entries.question: 政府可以怎麼減少貪腐？
entries.questionEnglish: How can a government reduce corruption?
entries.answer: 政府要公開資訊，才能減少貪腐。
entries.answerEnglish: A government needs to be transparent to reduce corruption.

entries.example: 英國王室常常上新聞。
entries.exampleEnglish: The British royal family is often in the news.
entries.question: 你的國家有王室嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your country have a royal family?
entries.answer: 沒有，我們國家沒有王室。
entries.answerEnglish: No, my country doesn't have a royal family.

entries.example: 工人用壓路機把路壓平。
entries.exampleEnglish: The workers flattened the road with a road roller.
entries.question: 你在路上看過壓路機嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a road roller on the street?
entries.answer: 看過，我家附近修路時有壓路機。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there was a road roller when they fixed the road near my home.

entries.example: 我家的貓喜歡待在高處。
entries.exampleEnglish: My cat likes to stay up high.
entries.question: 你怕站在高處嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are you afraid of standing in high places?
entries.answer: 有一點怕，我不喜歡站在高處。
entries.answerEnglish: A little. I don't like standing up high.

entries.example: 這家店的生意最近下滑了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop's business has slumped recently.
entries.question: 你覺得自己的體力有下滑嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you feel your stamina has declined?
entries.answer: 有，過了三十歲體力就下滑了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, my stamina dropped after I turned thirty.

entries.example: 他上班常遲到，被老闆開除了。
entries.exampleEnglish: He was often late to work, so his boss fired him.
entries.question: 公司在什麼情況下會開除員工？
entries.questionEnglish: In what situations does a company fire employees?
entries.answer: 員工常常遲到，可能就會被開除。
entries.answerEnglish: If employees are often late, they may get fired.

entries.example: 公司強制大家參加訓練。
entries.exampleEnglish: The company makes training mandatory for everyone.
entries.question: 你的公司會強制加班嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your company make overtime compulsory?
entries.answer: 不會，我們公司不會強制加班。
entries.answerEnglish: No, my company doesn't force us to work overtime.

entries.example: 他蹲下來綁鞋帶。
entries.exampleEnglish: He crouched down to tie his shoelaces.
entries.question: 你可以蹲很久嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Can you squat for a long time?
entries.answer: 不行，我蹲五分鐘腳就麻了。
entries.answerEnglish: No, after five minutes of squatting my legs go numb.

entries.example: 他花了五年償還學生貸款。
entries.exampleEnglish: He spent five years paying back his student loan.
entries.question: 在台北，房貸要多久才能償還？
entries.questionEnglish: In Taipei, how long does it take to pay off a mortgage?
entries.answer: 在台北，房貸可能要三十年才能償還。
entries.answerEnglish: In Taipei, a mortgage might take thirty years to pay off.

entries.example: 舞台上的聚光燈照在她身上。
entries.exampleEnglish: The spotlight on stage shone on her.
entries.question: 你喜歡站在聚光燈下嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like being in the spotlight?
entries.answer: 不喜歡，在聚光燈下我會很緊張。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I get very nervous in the spotlight.

entries.example: 他全然不知道這件事。
entries.exampleEnglish: He knew absolutely nothing about this.
entries.question: 有什麼事情是你全然不懂的？
entries.questionEnglish: Is there anything you know absolutely nothing about?
entries.answer: 我對股票全然不懂。
entries.answerEnglish: I know absolutely nothing about stocks.

entries.example: 這個三人組在街頭唱歌表演。
entries.exampleEnglish: This trio performs songs on the street.
entries.question: 你有固定的三人組朋友嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you have a regular trio of friends?
entries.answer: 有，我跟兩個同事是午餐三人組。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, two coworkers and I are a lunch trio.

entries.example: 迷路的時候，我覺得很無助。
entries.exampleEnglish: When I got lost, I felt really helpless.
entries.question: 在台灣，你什麼時候覺得很無助？
entries.questionEnglish: When have you felt helpless in Taiwan?
entries.answer: 剛來台灣看不懂中文時，我很無助。
entries.answerEnglish: When I first came and couldn't read Chinese, I felt helpless.

entries.example: 剛剛下了一陣大雨。
entries.exampleEnglish: There was just a burst of heavy rain.
entries.question: 你那裡下午常下一陣雨嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does it often rain for a spell in the afternoon where you are?
entries.answer: 常常，夏天下午常下一陣大雨。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. In summer there's often a burst of heavy rain in the afternoon.

entries.example: 我學會了三個吉他和弦。
entries.exampleEnglish: I've learned three guitar chords.
entries.question: 你會彈幾個吉他和弦？
entries.questionEnglish: How many guitar chords can you play?
entries.answer: 我只會彈四個簡單的和弦。
entries.answerEnglish: I can only play four simple chords.

entries.example: 這家店的名字很引人好奇。
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop's name is intriguing.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣有什麼引人好奇的習俗？
entries.questionEnglish: Which Taiwanese customs do you find intriguing?
entries.answer: 我覺得廟裡的抽籤很引人好奇。
entries.answerEnglish: I find the fortune sticks at temples intriguing.

entries.example: 颱風來之前，要做好預防措施。
entries.exampleEnglish: Before a typhoon arrives, you should take precautions.
entries.question: 颱風來之前，你會做什麼預防措施？
entries.questionEnglish: What precautions do you take before a typhoon?
entries.answer: 我會先買水和泡麵，當作預防措施。
entries.answerEnglish: As a precaution, I buy water and instant noodles.

entries.example: 吃餃子要加一點醋。
entries.exampleEnglish: Add a little vinegar when you eat dumplings.
entries.question: 你吃餃子喜歡加醋嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like vinegar with your dumplings?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我吃餃子一定加醋。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I always add vinegar to dumplings.

entries.example: 我爸爸四十歲就禿頭了。
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad went bald at forty.
entries.question: 你擔心以後會禿頭嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you worry about going bald later?
entries.answer: 有點擔心，我爸爸也是禿頭。
entries.answerEnglish: A little. My dad is bald too.

entries.example: 每天塞車上班很痛苦。
entries.exampleEnglish: Sitting in traffic to work every day is agony.
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你覺得很痛苦？
entries.questionEnglish: What feels like agony to you?
entries.answer: 早上很早起床讓我很痛苦。
entries.answerEnglish: Getting up really early is agony for me.

entries.example: 大浪把小船掀翻了。
entries.exampleEnglish: A big wave overturned the small boat.
entries.question: 颱風可能會掀翻什麼東西？
entries.questionEnglish: What can a typhoon blow over?
entries.answer: 颱風可能會掀翻屋頂和招牌。
entries.answerEnglish: A typhoon can blow off roofs and signboards.

entries.example: 老闆的話讓大家士氣大增。
entries.exampleEnglish: The boss's words gave everyone's morale a big boost.
entries.question: 你們公司怎麼提升士氣？
entries.questionEnglish: How does your company boost morale?
entries.answer: 我們公司會發獎金來提升士氣。
entries.answerEnglish: My company gives out bonuses to boost morale.

entries.example: 她工作很敬業，從不遲到。
entries.exampleEnglish: She's very dedicated to her work and is never late.
entries.question: 你覺得自己工作敬業嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're dedicated to your work?
entries.answer: 我覺得我很敬業，每天都很早到公司。
entries.answerEnglish: I think I'm very dedicated; I get to the office early every day.

entries.example: 雨停了，天上有一道彩虹。
entries.exampleEnglish: The rain stopped, and there was a rainbow in the sky.
entries.question: 你最近看過彩虹嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you seen a rainbow recently?
entries.answer: 看過，上週下完雨就有彩虹。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, there was a rainbow after the rain last week.

entries.example: 第一次坐飛機，我好興奮！
entries.exampleEnglish: I was so excited the first time I flew!
entries.question: 什麼事會讓你覺得很興奮？
entries.questionEnglish: What makes you feel really excited?
entries.answer: 要去旅行的時候，我會很興奮。
entries.answerEnglish: I get really excited when I'm about to travel.

entries.example: 這個披薩上有橄欖。
entries.exampleEnglish: There are olives on this pizza.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃橄欖嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like olives?
entries.answer: 不太喜歡，我覺得橄欖有點鹹。
entries.answerEnglish: Not really. I find olives a bit salty.

entries.example: 美國是一個聯邦國家。
entries.exampleEnglish: The United States is a federal country.
entries.question: 你的國家是聯邦制嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Is your country a federation?
entries.answer: 不是，我們國家不是聯邦制。
entries.answerEnglish: No, my country isn't a federation.

entries.example: 中秋節，大家在烤架上烤肉。
entries.exampleEnglish: At Mid-Autumn Festival, everyone barbecues on grills.
entries.question: 中秋節你會用烤架烤肉嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you barbecue on a grill at Mid-Autumn Festival?
entries.answer: 會，我們會在家門口用烤架烤肉。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, we barbecue on a grill in front of our home.

entries.example: 颱風迫近，大家都在準備。
entries.exampleEnglish: A typhoon is approaching, and everyone is getting ready.
entries.question: 截止日期迫近時，你會緊張嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you get nervous when a deadline is approaching?
entries.answer: 會，截止日期迫近時我常常熬夜。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when a deadline is near I often stay up late.

entries.example: 警察護送救護車到醫院。
entries.exampleEnglish: The police escorted the ambulance to the hospital.
entries.question: 什麼人出門需要有人護送？
entries.questionEnglish: What kind of people need an escort when they go out?
entries.answer: 總統出門需要警察護送。
entries.answerEnglish: The president needs a police escort when going out.

entries.example: 在台灣，買賣象牙是違法的。
entries.exampleEnglish: In Taiwan, buying and selling ivory is illegal.
entries.question: 你覺得應該禁止買賣象牙嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the ivory trade should be banned?
entries.answer: 應該，買賣象牙會傷害大象。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the ivory trade harms elephants.

entries.example: 我爸爸還留著很多錄音帶。
entries.exampleEnglish: My dad still keeps lots of cassette tapes.
entries.question: 你小時候用過錄音帶嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Did you use cassette tapes as a kid?
entries.answer: 用過，我以前用錄音帶聽音樂。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I used to listen to music on cassettes.

entries.example: 我的衣櫥已經滿了。
entries.exampleEnglish: My wardrobe is already full.
entries.question: 你的衣櫥裡衣服多嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Are there a lot of clothes in your wardrobe?
entries.answer: 很多，我的衣櫥快放不下了。
entries.answerEnglish: Lots. My wardrobe can barely hold them.

entries.example: 我在重要的地方劃線。
entries.exampleEnglish: I underline the important parts.
entries.question: 你看書時會劃線嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you underline things when you read?
entries.answer: 會，我會在重要的句子下面劃線。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I underline important sentences.

entries.example: 工人正在攪拌水泥。
entries.exampleEnglish: The workers are mixing cement.
entries.question: 你喜歡水泥牆的咖啡館嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like cafes with concrete walls?
entries.answer: 喜歡，水泥牆看起來很有個性。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, concrete walls have a lot of character.

entries.example: 他每天運動，身體很強健。
entries.exampleEnglish: He exercises every day and is very strong.
entries.question: 你怎麼讓身體更強健？
entries.questionEnglish: How do you make your body stronger?
entries.answer: 我每天跑步，讓身體更強健。
entries.answerEnglish: I run every day to make my body stronger.

entries.example: 今天的會議由經理主持。
entries.exampleEnglish: Today's meeting is chaired by the manager.
entries.question: 你主持過會議或活動嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever chaired a meeting or hosted an event?
entries.answer: 有，我主持過公司的尾牙。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I've hosted my company's year-end party.

entries.example: 新聞說今晚可以看到彗星。
entries.exampleEnglish: The news says we can see a comet tonight.
entries.question: 你親眼看過彗星嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever seen a comet with your own eyes?
entries.answer: 沒看過，我很想看一次彗星。
entries.answerEnglish: No, but I'd love to see a comet once.

entries.example: 吃太飽了，我把皮帶鬆開。
entries.exampleEnglish: I ate too much, so I loosened my belt.
entries.question: 吃太飽時，你會鬆開皮帶嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you've eaten too much, do you loosen your belt?
entries.answer: 會，吃到飽的時候我都會鬆開皮帶。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, at all-you-can-eat buffets I always loosen my belt.

entries.example: 海邊的椰子樹在風中搖曳。
entries.exampleEnglish: The palm trees by the sea sway in the wind.
entries.question: 你喜歡看樹在風中搖曳嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like watching trees sway in the wind?
entries.answer: 喜歡，看樹葉搖曳讓我很放鬆。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, watching leaves sway relaxes me.

entries.example: 這支手機的預設語言是英文。
entries.exampleEnglish: This phone's default language is English.
entries.question: 你的手機預設語言是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the default language on your phone?
entries.answer: 我手機的預設語言是中文。
entries.answerEnglish: My phone's default language is Chinese.

entries.example: 一杯咖啡賣三百塊，太離譜了！
entries.exampleEnglish: Three hundred dollars for a coffee? That's outrageous!
entries.question: 你遇過最離譜的價格是什麼？
entries.questionEnglish: What's the most outrageous price you've come across?
entries.answer: 機場的一瓶水賣一百塊，很離譜。
entries.answerEnglish: A bottle of water at the airport cost a hundred dollars. Ridiculous.

entries.example: 這顆芒果已經熟透了。
entries.exampleEnglish: This mango is fully ripe.
entries.question: 你喜歡吃熟透的香蕉嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like very ripe bananas?
entries.answer: 喜歡，熟透的香蕉比較甜。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, fully ripe bananas are sweeter.

entries.example: 經濟不好，大家覺得前景很黯淡。
entries.exampleEnglish: The economy is bad, and everyone feels the outlook is bleak.
entries.question: 你覺得你們行業的前景黯淡嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think the outlook for your industry is bleak?
entries.answer: 不會，我覺得前景沒有那麼黯淡。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I don't think the outlook is that bleak.

entries.example: 他喜歡喝台灣的威士忌。
entries.exampleEnglish: He likes drinking Taiwanese whisky.
entries.question: 你喝過台灣的威士忌嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever tried Taiwanese whisky?
entries.answer: 喝過，我覺得台灣的威士忌很好喝。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think Taiwanese whisky is really good.

entries.example: 請把表格裡的字對齊。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please align the text in the table.
entries.question: 整理桌子時，你會把東西對齊嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When you tidy your desk, do you line things up?
entries.answer: 會，我喜歡把書排好對齊。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I like to line my books up neatly.

entries.example: 現在下結論還過早。
entries.exampleEnglish: It's still too early to draw a conclusion.
entries.question: 你覺得現在買房子會過早嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think it's too early for you to buy a home now?
entries.answer: 會，我覺得現在買房子還過早。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I think it's still too early to buy a home.

entries.example: 如果身體不適，請先休息。
entries.exampleEnglish: If you feel unwell, please rest first.
entries.question: 搭飛機身體不適時，可以找誰？
entries.questionEnglish: Who can you ask for help if you feel unwell on a plane?
entries.answer: 身體不適時，可以找空服員幫忙。
entries.answerEnglish: If you feel unwell, you can ask a flight attendant for help.

entries.example: 車子開過去，水濺到我身上。
entries.exampleEnglish: A car drove past and splashed water on me.
entries.question: 下雨天，你被車子濺過水嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Have you ever been splashed by a car on a rainy day?
entries.answer: 有，昨天公車把水濺到我褲子上。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, yesterday a bus splashed water on my trousers.

entries.example: 這個便當很有營養。
entries.exampleEnglish: This lunch box is very nutritious.
entries.question: 你覺得你吃得有營養嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you eat nutritiously?
entries.answer: 還好，我會多吃青菜補充營養。
entries.answerEnglish: It's OK. I eat lots of vegetables for nutrition.

entries.example: 公司把兩個部門整併成一個。
entries.exampleEnglish: The company merged two departments into one.
entries.question: 你的公司有整併過部門嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Has your company ever merged departments?
entries.answer: 有，去年我們公司整併了兩個部門。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, last year my company merged two departments.

entries.example: 他剛來台灣時，生活很艱辛。
entries.exampleEnglish: Life was hard for him when he first came to Taiwan.
entries.question: 你覺得在國外生活艱辛嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you find life abroad hard?
entries.answer: 剛開始很艱辛，現在已經習慣了。
entries.answerEnglish: It was hard at first, but I'm used to it now.

entries.example: 請在表格上寫你的國籍。
entries.exampleEnglish: Please write your nationality on the form.
entries.question: 你有幾個國籍？
entries.questionEnglish: How many nationalities do you have?
entries.answer: 我只有一個國籍，是美國。
entries.answerEnglish: I only have one nationality: American.

entries.example: 房間很安靜，只聽到時鐘滴答響。
entries.exampleEnglish: The room is quiet; you can only hear the clock ticking.
entries.question: 時鐘的滴答聲會吵到你睡覺嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Does the ticking of a clock keep you awake?
entries.answer: 會，時鐘的滴答聲讓我睡不著。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the ticking of a clock keeps me awake.

entries.example: 在捷運上不能吃口香糖。
entries.exampleEnglish: You can't chew gum on the MRT.
entries.question: 你常常吃口香糖嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often chew gum?
entries.answer: 有時候，開會前我會吃口香糖。
entries.answerEnglish: Sometimes. I chew gum before meetings.

entries.example: 這家店賣很多可愛的飾品。
entries.exampleEnglish: This shop sells lots of cute accessories.
entries.question: 你喜歡戴飾品嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you like wearing accessories?
entries.answer: 喜歡，我常戴耳環和手鍊這些飾品。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I often wear accessories like earrings and bracelets.

entries.english: be called; be known as; dub
entries.example: 這種水果在台灣被稱作芭樂。
entries.exampleEnglish: This fruit is called bala in Taiwan.
entries.question: 你的家鄉有什麼特別的稱呼？
entries.questionEnglish: Does your hometown have a special nickname?
entries.answer: 我的家鄉被稱作雨城，因為常下雨。
entries.answerEnglish: My hometown is known as the Rain City because it rains a lot.

entries.example: 田邊有一條溝渠。
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a ditch beside the field.
entries.question: 下大雨時，你家附近的溝渠會淹水嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When it pours, do the ditches near your home flood?
entries.answer: 會，下大雨時溝渠的水常常滿出來。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when it pours the ditches often overflow.

entries.example: 心臟把血送到動脈。
entries.exampleEnglish: The heart pumps blood into the arteries.
entries.question: 什麼食物對動脈不好？
entries.questionEnglish: What foods are bad for the arteries?
entries.answer: 太油的食物對動脈不好。
entries.answerEnglish: Oily food is bad for the arteries.

entries.example: 表演結束，人群慢慢散開了。
entries.exampleEnglish: After the show, the crowd slowly dispersed.
entries.question: 下雨時，夜市的人會散開嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: When it rains, do the crowds at the night market scatter?
entries.answer: 會，一下雨，夜市的人就散開了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, as soon as it rains, the crowds scatter.

entries.example: 老舊的木門打開時好像在呻吟。
entries.exampleEnglish: The old wooden door seems to groan when it opens.
entries.question: 老房子的地板會發出呻吟聲嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do the floors in old houses groan?
entries.answer: 會，踩上去的時候，地板像在呻吟。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, when you step on them, the floorboards seem to groan.

entries.example: 他的論點很有道理。
entries.exampleEnglish: His argument makes a lot of sense.
entries.question: 開會時，你會提出自己的論點嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you put forward your own arguments in meetings?
entries.answer: 會，我會用資料支持我的論點。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I back up my arguments with data.

entries.example: 這張抵用券可以抵一百元。
entries.exampleEnglish: This voucher is worth a hundred dollars off.
entries.question: 你常用抵用券買東西嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you often use vouchers when you shop?
entries.answer: 常用，我買咖啡都會用抵用券。
entries.answerEnglish: Often. I always use vouchers when I buy coffee.

entries.example: 他年紀不大，卻很憤世嫉俗。
entries.exampleEnglish: He's not old, but he's very cynical.
entries.question: 你覺得自己憤世嫉俗嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're cynical?
entries.answer: 不會，我不是一個憤世嫉俗的人。
entries.answerEnglish: No, I'm not a cynical person.

entries.example: 我最喜歡貝多芬的第九號交響曲。
entries.exampleEnglish: My favorite is Beethoven's Ninth Symphony.
entries.question: 你聽過哪首有名的交響曲？
entries.questionEnglish: Which famous symphonies have you heard?
entries.answer: 我聽過貝多芬的第五號交響曲。
entries.answerEnglish: I've heard Beethoven's Fifth Symphony.

entries.example: 櫻花樹長出了很多花苞。
entries.exampleEnglish: The cherry tree has put out lots of buds.
entries.question: 你種的花有花苞了嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do the flowers you planted have buds yet?
entries.answer: 有，我陽台的玫瑰長出花苞了。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, the roses on my balcony have buds.

entries.example: 博物館介紹了那場大屠殺的歷史。
entries.exampleEnglish: The museum presents the history of that massacre.
entries.question: 為什麼要記得大屠殺的歷史？
entries.questionEnglish: Why should we remember the history of massacres?
entries.answer: 記得大屠殺的歷史，才能避免悲劇再發生。
entries.answerEnglish: Remembering the history of massacres helps prevent such tragedies from happening again.

entries.example: 山上的天氣難以預測。
entries.exampleEnglish: The weather in the mountains is unpredictable.
entries.question: 你覺得台灣的天氣難以預測嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think Taiwan's weather is unpredictable?
entries.answer: 對，台灣夏天的午後雷陣雨難以預測。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, summer afternoon thunderstorms in Taiwan are hard to predict.

entries.example: 小孩子都很有想像力。
entries.exampleEnglish: Little kids are all very imaginative.
entries.question: 你覺得自己有想像力嗎？
entries.questionEnglish: Do you think you're imaginative?
entries.answer: 有，我很喜歡想故事，滿有想像力的。
entries.answerEnglish: Yes, I love making up stories; I'm pretty imaginative.
